description:
Parent: fz-kdt

The owner's direction (2026-08-30), BEAM-inspired: analysis identity should
coalesce at name/arity (per root) -- specializations ROOTED there as content,
with value-keyed identities minted only AT SETTLEMENT where the backend needs
them (quicksort(int) != quicksort(float) as executables, not as free-floating
demanded analysis identities). BEAM's M:F/A is the only identity; clause
selection is behavior, not naming.

## The measured case
- ~20% of AnalyzeActivation evaluations land on identities that never reach
  the artifact (231/1081, 60/306, 120/886 across the three target fixtures;
  67/14/32 abandoned intermediate keys) -- warm-up work on names that stop
  existing, plus the indirect cost of their ReturnType bumps waking callers.
- 98% of preservation traffic is key migration (fz-kdt.69's measurement):
  value-named identities churn by construction under a monotone ascent.
- The widening budget, convergence_class, fz-y6w's collapse, fz-kdt.65's
  ladder are all compensation for minting identities from ascending values.

## The shape
- Stable analysis cell per (root, function) -- or per (root, function,
  dispatch-class): the body determines a FINITE set of clause-dispatch
  outcomes and DispatchMask already projects to dispatch-relevant positions.
  Evidence ascends WITHIN a class as cell content; classes don't churn.
- Identity at settlement: settled evidence crystallizes into value-keyed
  ExecutableKeys (the backend already derives these from settled activations).
- Prior art in-tree: the SpecKey/BodyKey split (fz-xqw) already separates
  demanded-identity from body-identity.

## THE central design question (decides feasibility)
Within-class evidence joins during the ascent. Today's per-arrow keys give
per-type return evidence; a class-rooted cell could widen conclusions
(int|float joining where they ascend separately today). Either per-evidence
rows live as the cell's settled CONTENT without being demanded identities, or
the artifact loses precision. The inventory-width pins (59/221/214) and the
canonical backend form are the instruments: any artifact movement is the
answer.

## Process
Full treatment: investigate (measure per-function arrow-family sizes and
within-class join effects), propose to a cold agent, integrate, decompose.
Sequenced AFTER fz-kdt.69 (whose edge/index groundwork any model needs, and
whose Story 1 producer-map fix is required under every model).

## BLOCKED BY

- ○ fz-kdt.69 P2 A preserved claim keeps its claim but loses its subscriptions

## TRANSITION PROTOCOL (how we fold in the new and delete the old without getting lost)

The durable stores are the memory; conversation is scratch. Compaction has
already happened repeatedly in this project without losing the thread, for
exactly these reasons -- now law for this epic:

1. THE TREE EXPLAINS ITSELF AT EVERY STAGE BOUNDARY. Each stage lands green,
   gated, docs matching (present-tense; unbuilt state lives in tickets). The
   test is literal: a cold agent given only repo+bw must be able to state the
   migration's status and next step. Run that COLD NAVIGATOR drill between
   stages; if its answer diverges from ours, fix the RECORD, not the agent.
2. ONE TRUTH + DERIVED SHADOW, never two truths. During dual-write, exactly
   one side is authoritative; the other is derived and continuously verified
   by an equivalence instrument (standing test: old facts == derived-from-new
   where they overlap; the canon-introduction pattern). Cutover = swap the
   derivation direction behind the same instrument.
3. ARTIFACT CONSTANCY IS THE THREAD. Every stage: canonical backend
   byte-compare + inventory pins hold, until a stage explicitly claims a
   WORK-COUNT change (never an artifact change). Any lost session can verify
   correctness with one command.
4. SCAFFOLD INVENTORY, CI-ENFORCED. Every temporarily-live compat mechanism
   is listed in one fact-engine.md migration section, each entry naming its
   owning stage ticket; a grep-style gate test (boundary-gate pattern)
   asserts the inventory matches the tree. Scaffolding without a listed
   owner fails the build. Same-commit deletion stays the rule wherever the
   supersession is complete (rip-out law); the inventory exists only for
   spans the stages force.
5. NUMBERS CARRY THEIR RECIPES. Every measured claim in tickets/commits
   states lens (CLI vs PublicTrace), build profile, fixture -- the
   1,353-vs-1,383 lens confusion is the precedent. Re-measure at HEAD before
   trusting any number older than the last landed stage; schedule one
   RE-TRIAGE ticket at the epic midpoint (fz-f98.811514239 precedent).
6. THE GRAVEYARD IS PART OF THE MAP. Refuted designs (settled-wait folds,
   cause-scoped dirtiness, finality-first pop, edge-derived demand over
   value keys) stay listed in this epic with one-line kill reasons and
   pointers -- no future context re-walks them.
7. TICKET-FIRST CLOSE-OUT. At each stage close: rewrite (never layer) the
   parent's live 'State of the migration' section, close the child, THEN
   report. Reports compact; tickets don't.
8. EACH STAGE LANDS-OR-PARKS ON ITS OWN EVIDENCE, and each must retire at
   least one old mechanism or be explicitly ticketed scaffolding -- no dead
   weight waiting on stage 3 (park precedents: 13.2 at 77f87512c, 69.3 at
   9d65ab25e; parking is a recorded outcome, not a failure).
9. THE LOOP IS THE VEHICLE: investigate -> (cold design review for new
   design ground) -> fresh-context builder -> adversarial refuter -> fixes
   folded -> land/park. Fresh contexts are the feature: every builder
   re-derives from durable stores, continuously testing that the stores
   suffice.
10. STACKED DRAFT PRs per stage keep human review in scope (PR #106/#107
    precedent).

The protocol is the target architecture applied to ourselves: identity is
structure (the ticket graph, the docs, the instruments), evidence is content
(measurements with recipes, rewritten state sections), shadows are verified
derivations, and deletion follows supersession. Nothing load-bearing is named
by a value that moves -- least of all a chat transcript.
title: Coalesce analysis identity at name/arity: dispatch-class roots, value identity at settlement
